abstract: The fluorescent dye Hoechst 33342 is able to differentiate F9 EC cells at low concentrations. This differentiation is accompanied by synthesis of large amounts of laminin, production of a well-developed cytoskeleton, disappearance of the SSEA-1 antigen, and synthesis of large amounts of fibronectin, all characteristics of the primitive endoderm. The dye immediately blocks the cells at the S/G2 phase of the cell cycle and produces a complete arrest in proliferation. This effect is not specific for the nullipotent F9 cell line, as multipotent EC cell lines like PCC3, P19, and PCC4 can also be easily differentiated into the same pathway by treatment with the Hoechst dye. In contrast, the dye has no remarkable effects on terminal differentiated, immortalized cells like NIH 3T3 or the parietal endoderm-like cell PYS-2.
abstract_ja: 蛍光色素Hoechst 33342は、低濃度でF9 EC細胞を分化させます。この分化には、ラミニンの大量合成、発達した細胞骨格の形成、SSEA-1抗原の消失、フィブロネクチンの大量合成が伴い、これらはすべて原始内胚葉の特徴です。本色素は細胞をS/G2期で停止させ、増殖を完全に抑制します。この効果はヌリポテント（nullipotent）なF9細胞株に限られず、多能性EC細胞株であるPCC3、P19、PCC4も、本色素処理により同じ経路へ容易に分化させることができます。対照的に、本色素は終末分化し不死化した細胞であるNIH 3T3や、壁側内胚葉様細胞であるPYS-2には顕著な影響を与えません。
